ValidationRule.description: Rule to block parent account for agent accounts.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Administrador do sistema', $Profile.Name <> 'API Only profile', NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, "Master Data")), RecordType.DeveloperName == 'PMC_SS_Agent', NOT(ISBLANK( ParentId )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Agent accounts are standalone accounts and cannot have parents
